action: Formally accept Rick Tanner's two-week timeline for the Millfield Auto Mall consolidation readiness assessment. Confirm in writing that his three-tier asset map — not a layoff list — is the authoritative document I will use for any Q2 consolidation decisions. Signal to him directly that the service lane is the survival core and that I will not make staffing decisions that undercut certified technician capacity. This is the strategic pivot I have been building toward: from a four-location sales-volume model to a service-and-retention model built around the parts of the business that autonomous ride-share cannot touch.
